fact: French journalists Sebastian Perez Pezzani and Gaël Mocaër and Togolese fixer Komi Mawufemo Vedomey were arrested on 27 July 2026 while filming a documentary in northern Togo and held 26 days, over alleged false statements on visa applications.
title: 2 French journalists, Togolese fixer detained 26 days following arrest while documentary filming in northern Togo
